name: Mona
title: Astral Reflection
description: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.

skills.name: Ripple of Fate
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 water splash attacks that deal Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Hydro DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the might of Hydro, Mona plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.

skills.name: Mirror Reflection of Doom
skills.description:
Creates an illusory Phantom of Fate from coalesced waterspouts.

Phantom
Has the following special properties:
·Continuously taunts nearby opponents, attracting their fire.
·Continuously deals Hydro DMG to nearby opponents.
·When its duration expires, the Phantom explodes, dealing AoE Hydro DMG.

Hold
Utilizes water currents to move backwards swiftly before conjuring a Phantom.

Only one Phantom created by Mirror Reflection of Doom can exist at any time.
skills.info: Skilled astrologers have always dreamed of using a phantom facsimile of themselves to ward off imminent ill fate, but Mona must be the first to make such a mockery of it in all of Teyvat.

skills.name: Illusory Torrent
skills.description:
Alternate Sprint
Mona cloaks herself within the water's flow, consuming Stamina to move rapidly.

When under the effect of Illusory Torrent, Mona can move at high speed on water.
Applies the Wet status to nearby opponents when she reappears.
skills.info: This is something that Mona can do, but her teacher cannot. Well, but it's not as if her teacher would pursue any matter concerning Hydro Visions anyway...

skills.name: Stellaris Phantasm
skills.description:
Mona summons the sparkling waves and creates a reflection of the starry sky, applying the Illusory Bubble status to opponents in a large AoE.

Illusory Bubble
Traps opponents inside a pocket of destiny and also makes them Wet. Renders weaker opponents immobile.
When an opponent affected by Illusory Bubble sustains DMG, it has the following effects:
·Applies an Omen to the opponent, which gives a DMG Bonus, also increasing the DMG of the attack that causes it.
·Removes the Illusory Bubble, dealing Hydro DMG in the process.

Omen
During its duration, increases DMG taken by opponents.
skills.info: It was from the time that gods first traced the lights in the heavens with their eyes that the notion of "fate" was born.

passives.name: "Come 'n' Get Me, Hag!"
passives.description:
After she has used Illusory Torrent for 2s, if there are any opponents nearby, Mona will automatically create a Phantom.
A Phantom created in this manner lasts for 2s, and its explosion DMG is equal to 50% of Mirror Reflection of Doom.

passives.name: Waterborne Destiny
passives.description: Increases Mona's Hydro DMG Bonus by a degree equivalent to 20% of her Energy Recharge rate.

passives.name: Principium of Astrology
passives.description: When Mona crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, she has a 25% chance to refund a portion of the crafting materials used.

constellations.name: Prophecy of Submersion
constellations.description:
When any of your own party members hits an opponent affected by an Omen, the effects of Hydro-related Elemental Reactions are enhanced for 8s:
· Electro-Charged DMG increases by 15%, Lunar-Charged DMG increases by 15%, Vaporize DMG increases by 15%, Hydro Swirl DMG increases by 15%, Lunar-Crystallize DMG increases by 15%.
· Frozen duration is extended by 15%.

constellations.name: Lunar Chain
constellations.description:
When a Normal Attack hits, there is a 20% chance that it will be automatically followed by a Charged Attack.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.

constellations.name: Restless Revolution
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Stellaris Phantasm by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Prophecy of Oblivion
constellations.description: When any party member attacks an opponent affected by an Omen, their CRIT Rate is increased by 15%.

constellations.name: Mockery of Fortuna
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Mirror Reflection of Doom by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Rhetorics of Calamitas
constellations.description:
Upon entering Illusory Torrent, Mona gains a 60% increase to the DMG of her next Charged Attack per second of movement.
A maximum DMG Bonus of 180% can be achieved in this manner. The effect lasts for no more than 8s.

outfits.name: Pact of Stars and Moon
outfits.description: Mona's outfit. A costume made specifically to encompass the astrological concept of "the destined moment," thanks to the 30% discount ticket she got from the celestial globe refund.

outfits.name: Flowing Fate
outfits.description: Mona's outfit. A light astrologist's outfit that does away with superfluous fabric to provide top quality at an affordable price.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: I am Astrologist Mona Megistus, meaning "The Great Astrologist Mona." If it is divination you seek from me, then I ask you respect my name by learning it wholly, here and now.

voices.title: Chat: Astrology
voices.text: Divination is about precisely foretelling one's written destiny. Over-embellishing that fate only leads to misconception.

voices.title: Chat: Life
voices.text: Astrologers must rid themselves of material desires. Only by ridding oneself of clutter can one see the true world around them.

voices.title: Chat: Fate
voices.text: Fate is called as such, for it cannot be changed, nor can it be reversed. It can only but be accepted.

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: With rain this heavy, not only are the stars clouded, so too is my scryglass hazy.

voices.title: When Thunder Strikes
voices.text: Which of the starry skies do these thunderbolts fall from?

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: The pure waters of melted snow are optimal for hydromancy.

voices.title: When the Sun Is Out
voices.text: One need not scry to know today's weather will be good.

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: Your arrival is untimely. The morning star has just waned... Breakfast? No, I—I've already eaten.

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Noon is upon us, we should eat. Hm? I... I will have a salad, for simplicity is the way of the astrologer.

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: Nightfall has arrived. I will soon be able to begin my divination. Ah... Did I finish writing my astrology column last night...?

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: It's already so late, and I'm no further along on finishing tomorrow's astrology column. What? You're off to sleep? *sigh* I wish I could sleep now too...

voices.title: About Mona
voices.text: The work of the astrologer is to show people what fate has in store for them, and that's exactly what I do. There will always be those, however, who are unable to accept what they are told.

voices.title: About Us: Work
voices.text: Why do I write reports rather than using my divination to earn Mora? I would never use hydromancy for the sake of Mora, nor did I learn hydromancy for that purpose.

voices.title: About Us: My Fate
voices.text: I don't know. Unless left with no other choice, astrologers do not foretell their own fate. The elders of my art warned against it, for it can turn fate in on itself, which is incredibly dangerous.

voices.title: About Us: Your Fate
voices.text: As you are not from this world, I am unable to give you a prediction. All I can tell you is that your journey is far from over.

voices.title: About the Vision: Disdain
voices.text: When I first received my Vision, the elderly woman that gave it to me, she put on this air and said "May your heart of truth be with you." And yet this thing does nothing for my hydromancy, all it does is get me wet.

voices.title: About the Vision: Value
voices.text: That said, a Vision doesn't hurt to have as a little accessory. It is, after all, the one useful study tool that miserly old lady ever gave me, in a rare act of generosity.

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: Do you know about constellations? Astrologers believe that the patterns of the stars map out the destiny of Vision bearers — past, present, and future, everything is written in the stars.

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: This... travel companion of yours — do you know anything of her origins? No matter what, I cannot seem to discern a single shred of information regarding this floating fairy's fate.\n...Oh? So you don't know where she comes from, either?

voices.title: About Jean
voices.text: You mean the Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius? Her constellation is Leo Minor, which represents strength and responsibility shouldered too young... Though the lioness has been separated from her pride for a long time, she grows from strength to strength, and the day will come when she is ready to return as its glorious leader.

voices.title: About Albedo
voices.text: Albedo? Ah... I envy his ability to solely focus on his research without getting bogged down in mundane worldly affairs. What a wonderful life! If that batty old lady hadn't had one too many screws loose, perhaps that's the life I'd be living by now myself...

voices.title: About Klee
voices.text: Ah yes, Alice's daughter. She's in the custody of the Knights of Favonius, and Albedo looks after her too. She's blessed to have Trifolium as her constellation, which represents good luck. I'm slightly envious... *smirk*\nAlthough, if I'd been blessed with good luck, I suppose I never would have had the great honor of running into that old woman, would I...

voices.title: About Diluc
voices.text: Diluc Ragnvindr. His constellation, Noctua, represents vigilance in the darkness of night... A lone guardian keeping watch, longing for the splendor of dawn, yet destined to solitude in the dark days preceding its arrival.\n...Or, wait, maybe Noctua's the one tied to wealth...?

voices.title: About Kaeya
voices.text: Kaeya Alberich? He's a Pavo Ocellus. Destined for greatness and grandeur... and to hide ugly realities behind a layer of charm and elegance. He believes he has made a clean break with his past, but one day fate will catch up with him. When it does, he will have a major decision to make.

voices.title: About Lisa
voices.text: A Tempus Fugit... The constellation derives its name from the hourglass, and stands for knowledge and time — or rather, the trade-off between them. As each grain of sand falls down, a moment of time — of life, even, dies for good. To stop the unrelenting flow of sand, one would have to turn the hourglass on its side. But once the sand comes to rest, it remains motionless forever... Hmm, maybe "becomes lazy" is more accurate than "comes to rest," in this case.

voices.title: About Venti
voices.text: Venti? The bard that sits around doing nothing all day? What's so interesting about him? Sure, I guess I can take a look...\nHuh, that's weird, the scryglass, it's... I can't see a thing... this wind... I can't... open my eyes! No, my hat! Ah! My clothes, stop! The wind's going to strip all my clothes off! Make it stop, make it stop! ...Alright, alright! I'll never do this again!

voices.title: More About Mona: I
voices.text: You want to chat... for fun? Oh... I don't usually have spare time for such activities, especially when I have so many columns left to write... Then again, since it's you, it might be worth it. Hehe, a change of pace once in a while isn't such a bad thing.

voices.title: More About Mona: II
voices.text: Income? From astrology...? You can't use... things like Mora to determine the value of astrology! You need to understand: hydromancy is the one and only means of discerning people's true destiny in the whole of Teyvat! No matter how much Mora or gems you might have, the value of fate is quite simply incalculable! Perhaps not the smartest question you might have had for me...

voices.title: More About Mona: III
voices.text: You want me to explain how astrology works? I'm not sure you'd understand even if I told you. But since you ask... The method I use is called hydromancy. The art of inferring fate from the illusory reflection of the stars on the water's surface. The inverted reflection in the water is an image of the heavens from within which the truth of our world can be observed. ...It is the one and only success story of that old lady's research endeavors.

voices.title: More About Mona: IV
voices.text: Mona Megistus, the Astrologist — we came up with that name together, the old lady and me. She said it had a nice ring to it... But then she started calling me 'Meg' for short, which is obviously unnecessary, because clearly 'Mona' is already suffice for a shorter name— No! You are NOT allowed to call me that, it's embarrassing! Gah! I knew I shouldn't have told you!

voices.title: More About Mona: V
voices.text: The golden rule all fortune-tellers abide by is: never offer advice. Only state the results of the divination. Otherwise, you risk your fate becoming tangled up with that of your subject. But for you, I will make an exception to this rule — because our fates have been intertwined from the beginning.

voices.title: Mona's Hobbies
voices.text: My hobby? Stargazing! In this all-too-real world in which we live, we all need to look up from the dust once in a while and fix our gaze on the stars, in a spirit of wonder... That, plus the whole thing about me being an astrologer.

voices.title: Mona's Troubles
voices.text: *sigh* The equipment repair bill is due, and so is the final payment for that celestial globe I ordered... Also, I still need to renew my journal subscriptions, not to mention pay the rent... Hmm, which one to prioritize? ...Ah, I'll pay off the celestial globe first. If I leave it any longer, they'll sell out, and then I'll never get my hands on one...

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: Salad. Salad is by far the best food in the world. Cheap to buy, easy to whip up, filling, and it's the most convenient thing there is when you're working on a column or fixing some equipment — I mean, who's got time for a proper dinner anyway?

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: You know, all those... overpriced, fancy foods. Personally, I think it's uncivilized and, frankly, dangerous to splash out and indulge yourself every time you have a little hunger pang.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: Ah, so satisfied... Who would have thought knowing you would bear so many benefits.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: Just to be clear... you're sure I don't have to pay... for any of this?

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: I don't mean to nitpick, or anything, it's just... I haven't quite eaten enough.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy Birthday. Here's my gift to you — it's a bag containing some words of advice that may help you through tough patches. ...No, don't open it yet. During the year ahead, this bag will open itself when the right time comes.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: This was ordained by fate! Long had I foreseen it.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: ...One step closer. Maybe soon I shall finally uncover the truth of this world?

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: My scryglass has long since preordained all that will take place beneath the stars it reflects.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: In the reflection of the water, I see the ascension of the morning star.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Let me scry!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Shadows of fate!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Delve into destiny!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Fate is upon you.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Written in the stars!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Decided by destiny!

voices.title: Deploying Wind Glider: I
voices.text: Scry the sky!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: We could do with some more fortune...

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: This should cover food and rent for a while!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: Ah, finding treasure is pretty exhilarating!

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: My vision is clouded...

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: Odius fate...

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: This was not foretold!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Do not tempt fate.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: This is not your destiny.

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: The stars... are fading...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: Destiny cannot be... denied.

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: My reckoning... has come...

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Curses.

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Leave my space!

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: This is destiny.

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: This is how it must be.

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: It is as the stars foretold.
